#microbe group and all germination
```{r}
pollen_micriobe%>%
  mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,
         levels=c("15m","45m","90m","3h","4h","6h","12h","24h")))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=microbetreatment,
             y=allgerm,
             fill=microbetreatment))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  facet_wrap(~timepoint, nrow=2)+
  labs(title="Microbe Treatment and All Germinated",
       x="Microbe Treatment",
       y="Proportion of Germinated")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```
